title: Heavyweight
paragraphs: “So it’s a fighting style that combines both close-range and long-range combat, huh…”
“Of course, you know she can keep up with flying opponents too, right?”
“She throws rocks, after all. If you get too close, her quick-moving nose will snare you and slam you into the ground, or choke you… or just punch you.”

“That kind of performance is part of the secret to her popularity, too. She makes her opponents dance with the ground tremors while toying with them… That’s why she earned the nickname ‘Queen of the Earthquakes’ at the Zeltoble Colosseum.”
“Lasa! Stop badmouthing me!”
“Oh, yeah, yeah. You’re totally in the zone now, aren’t you?”
“So she’s got that ‘Queen’ vibe…”
Father looks a little taken aback. Panda’s grinning from ear to ear.

“Well, to be fair to Elmero’s honor—she’s not doing this because she wants to, so you shouldn’t worry about it, right? It feels like she’s being forced to do it as a gladiator. Though it does seem like he’s being his true self.”
“Well… he did look like he was having a lot of fun when he was playing with Sakura-chan and the others.”

This is it! A fighter who battles in the Colosseum for the sake of the children… a rival of Filolial Mask. Come to think of it, I feel like we fought him in the last loop. I’d forgotten because I took him out right at the start.
“Filolial Mask is really making a name for himself in the Colosseum.”
“Who’s that guy? He’s kind of intriguing.”
“That’s the ring name I used in the Colosseum during the last loop.”
“We might share the same love for kids, but I definitely don’t want to fight him.”
“Yeah… I’m saying this because I know how strong the Spear Hero is, but someone like Elmero wouldn’t even be a match, would he?”
“HAHAHA!”
“Stop laughing… I feel sorry for whoever runs into Motoyasu-kun in Zeltoble.”
That’s Takt, isn’t it! If I see him in the Colosseum next time, I’ll take care of him after the tournament.
“I wonder how I did?”
“We might have met.”
Though, I’d think the panda would definitely remember me. Unless it was transformed into a pig, of course.

But timing-wise, it might not have been there during the period we were staying there. In the loop where I was peddling goods in Melromarc with Father, I was in Siltvelt until around the time of the second wave.
“You don’t remember…? Lars-chan, please rest in peace.”
“That’s no joke, so please stop. So, Sir Knight, how are you going to deal with that Queen of Earthquakes?”
“Oh, it looks like Eclair is about to do something.”
Éclair is dodging while placing her hand on her sword and channeling Magical Power and strength into it. Then, keeping her center of gravity low, she dodges the rock Zou threw and closes in rapidly.
“Your weaknesses are, as expected, your sluggish movements and the fact that your massive frame makes you a large target. So I’ll exploit those weaknesses. Haaaaaah!”

She closed in by ducking beneath his legs, and just as Zou—alert to the maneuver—was about to cast Magic to protect his back, Éclair stopped right in front of him and thrust her sword toward his solar plexus. With a satisfying “thwack,” a shockwave seemed to travel all the way through to Zou’s back. The elephant looked as if it had been knocked off balance.
“Ugh…”

Éclair immediately leaped back and began shifting her stance slightly, as if planning her next move. It was a style of dancing like a butterfly and stinging like a bee. Seeing this, Zou sat down on his haunches as if he’d given up.
“Ouch, you’ve got quite the punch there.”
“Oh? Are you stopping here? I didn’t think it went in that deep, and I was actually thinking about my next move…”
Looking somewhat unsatisfied, Éclair sheathes her sword.
“I misread your next move—I lose. I underestimated you far too much.”
“By the way, if you’d known I was going to use the same move, what were you planning to do?”
“Well, that’s…”
Zou is moving his trunk at an incredible speed. Isn’t that the fastest part of his body?
“...I see. If I were hit by that attack, it would be difficult to aim for your stomach head-on.”
“Since you were on guard, I didn’t expect you to come at me head-on. That’s quite bold of you.”

“I’m well aware it’s sometimes necessary. Judging by the resistance I felt, your physical strength and endurance seem like they’d be a real challenge… It’s only natural that you’ve been appointed as Lord Iwatani’s Guardian Knight.”

That sturdiness certainly makes you perfect as Father’s bodyguard. Well, since Father is the Shield Hero, I’m not sure if he actually needs one. But having an ally who can defend should give us more strategic options than relying solely on Father. Above all, since Zou is a power-type fighter, we could have Father draw in the attacks while Zou delivers the finishing blow.
“Don’t you think you should focus a little more on using Magic, Sir Knight? You’re too fixated on swordsmanship.”
“……That’s a bit of a hard pill to swallow. But since this is a rare opportunity, I suppose I’ll give it a try.”
“By the way, in the first world, Éclair belonged to a school called the ‘Hengen Muso Style,’ where she learned various techniques and used them almost like Magic, didn’t she?”
Éclair looks a bit uneasy. I offered that advice based on my loop experience, but her reaction is a bit lukewarm. I wonder what she doesn’t like about it?
“Motoyasu-kun……”
“You need to choose your time and place.”
Father and Rival are muttering something to each other. Did I say something wrong?
“…Well, I suppose a knight’s fighting style would work against most heavyweights.”
“By the way, Larsazusa, how do you plan to defeat Lord Elmero?”
“Last time he won, he tied him up with bamboo, didn’t he? He got caught pretty easily.”
“On the other hand, there was that time you charged in recklessly, got caught by me, slammed into the ground, and got knocked out, wasn’t there?”
“Ha! You’ve forgotten about something that old, haven’t you!”
Panda just ignores the Elephant’s reply as if she doesn’t know anything about it.
“So, Shield Hero. Do you get how we fight now?”
“Yeah, you’re all really strong. It’d be fun to figure out how to use you all strategically.”
“Exactly!”
Father seems to enjoy this kind of teamwork. If it weren’t for the whole “training Rival” thing, I’d ask Sakura-chan and the others to handle it.
“Personally, I think it’d be just right to have Shield Hero literally hold Elmero by the arm or around the nose and use him as a shield.”
“Rasa!”
“That’s a bit much, don’t you think? Especially since we have to protect Lord Iwatani.”
“Ahaha… That’s a full-fledged heavyweight tank. That combination… Well, my role as the Shield Hero is to protect and support everyone in the first place.”
Father gave a wry smile.
“Panda… I won’t stand for you making Father do something like that.”
“How is that any different from protecting them while riding the Filolial? I think it’s a good formation, don’t you?”

So Father rides on the elephant’s back, gets lifted by its trunk, and even sits on its hand, huh? …Considering how slow elephants are, that might actually be a good idea… Well, at least the elephant itself can handle the attacking. Just like with that Éclair earlier, Father can provide support for attacks aimed at the solar plexus. But wouldn’t we be able to protect everyone more quickly if we didn’t bring the elephant along?

“Judging by the way Elmero fights, it might be more efficient to have him provide support from the rear by throwing rocks. Or perhaps a ‘catapult style’ where he actually hurls his allies to close in on the enemy?”
“Hey! What are you saying?!”
At that, Zou flashes a sinister grin, as if hatching a scheme, and cracks his knuckles.
“That sounds great. Since Lasa can both defend and attack, I’ve been dying to hurl her around. She’s round and just the right size, I think.”
“You’ve got to be kidding me!”
“Hmm… It looks like we can take on this battle with a rather unique team composition.”
Éclair nodded with satisfaction.
“Whoa, is it over already?”

When I looked toward the voice, I spotted my Finacée, Sakura-chan, Yuki-chan, and Kou watching from a castle window a short distance away. It seems they’d been watching the match. When I waved, Sakura-chan and the others waved back. And just like that, Éclair and the others’ training session came to an end.
After that, Father took Éclair and the others to Siltvelt to go on a monster-hunting expedition to train Rival. Meanwhile, we set out on a journey around the world to slay dragons.

I really didn’t want to do it, but it’s better than doing nothing. Plus, we could do it while also leveling up the Filolial-samas. So, we rotated the Filolial-samas at the castle on a regular basis as we traveled around slaying dragons and monsters in various regions.
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Liberation Fire Eye X! Liberation Prominence X! Hahaha! You’re weak!　Way too weak!”
Facing the monsters that keep pouring out like water from their lairs far from human settlements, I’m letting off all the steam I’ve built up from the folks at Shieldfreeden and Rival.
“Motoyasu Biiiiiiiiim!”
Liberation Fire Eye is just as handy as a Brionac. Sweeping attacks are a breeze!
“Whoa! That’s amazing!”
“Magic’s coming out of your eyes!”
“Let’s give it our all, too!”

It’s heartwarming to see Filolial-sama, whom I brought along, running around full of enthusiasm. I can even stock up on food while I’m out hunting. Of course, I’ve already collected Bio-Plant seeds as I’ve been traveling around.

I’ve seen Father put these seeds to good use time and time again. With these, not only will the food shortage in Shieldfreeden be solved, but the food crises happening all over the world will be resolved in one fell swoop. There’s absolutely no room for Rival to slip into Father-in-law’s list of people he evaluates!
“Hahahahaha! I’ll wipe out dragons and griffins once and for all!”

Of course, while I was at it, I also destroyed the secret fortress of the Three Heroes Church in Melromarc. It seems it wasn’t fully operational, so there wasn’t much to gain from it. I’ve reported everything in full to the Queen.
I stormed in while searching for the Trash. Unfortunately, he wasn’t there. Where on earth is he hiding?

So, I spent my time productively, gathering a mountain of materials, loot, and Dragon Emperor shards before returning. When I returned to Siltvelt Castle, Father and the others were resting in the garden—it seemed they’d just come back from a hunt. Of course, perhaps because Siltvelt wants to treat Father—the Shield Hero—with the utmost respect, they appear to be setting up temporary chairs and tents around him. Father explained with a look of exasperation that he was just resting.
“Naofumi, the Spear Hero has returned.”
Rival spotted me and told Father. Hasn’t he grown quite a bit? He’s now almost as tall as Father. But! He’s nowhere near the pace at which Filolial-sama is growing!
“Oh, Motoyasu and the others are back, too.”
“That’s right! Here’s a gift for you.”

I’ll toss the bag filled with fragments of the Dragon Emperor at Rival. With a “chomp,” he catches the bag in his mouth. I thought he might smash it right into his face to make a spectacle of himself and slyly score some points with Father, but he’s being quite well-behaved.
“There’s a lot of the other materials, so I’d appreciate it if you could come back later to pick them up, Father.”
“Sure. They’re essential for our own strengthening anyway, and it never hurts to gather supplies in preparation for future battles.”
“We’re making good progress, aren’t we?”
Rival used his tongue to pick out the Dragon Emperor’s shards from the bag I’d handed him, swallowed them all, and said that. He’s gotten smaller, you know.
“…Haven’t you shrunk a bit?”
“I’ve learned how to adjust my size now. Since I have more transformation variations, I can change to the size Naofumi requested.”
“You’re still such a sly one!”
“I’d prefer you call it ‘versatility.’”
What kind of versatility is that? You’re only good for breaking through level caps, that’s all.
“Now, now…”
“Once we’re in combat, I’ll be able to assist Naofumi and the others even more. Or would it be better for me to fight on the front lines?”
“Hmm… All things considered, Eclair and the others are pretty capable. I wonder if we’ll manage to pull off enough attacks?”
“It’s hard to say we’ll advance as relentlessly as the Spear Hero or the Filolials.”
“Don’t compare us to them!”
The panda, who was resting in the rear, objects to Rival’s remark. Naturally. No matter how excellent you lot are as mercenaries or knights, I have no intention of losing.
“Well… if we want to be efficient, maybe we should let Motoyasu-kun take care of Éclair and the others to level them up first, and then have them help us level up over here?”
When Father muttered that, Éclair flinched slightly before putting on a calm front and sipping the tea that had been served to her.
“Um… Miss Éclair, is there anything special about leveling up while traveling with the Spear Hero?”
“…To put it simply, it involves riding on a Filolial’s back and galloping through the wilds.”
Éclair quietly answered Zou’s question. That’s right! It’s a really fun ride!
“Isn’t it just a bit bumpy? We rode on it on the way to the dragon’s lair, didn’t we?”
“You can’t just brush it off like that. That was… a hit-and-run.”
